channel_a_rest.channel: Plane REST (X-Api-Key) — independent of the MCP write lane

work_item_detail_probe.explanation: Plane's `Issue.issue_objects` manager excludes DRAFT work items (apps/api/plane/db/models/issue.py), and BOTH the external work-item LIST and DETAIL endpoints query through it (apps/api/plane/api/views/issue.py — IssueListCreateAPIEndpoint.get_queryset / IssueDetailAPIEndpoint.get_queryset). The MCP server proxies the same REST route, so `plane_retrieve_work_item` and `plane_retrieve_work_item_by_identifier` return the same 404. => A byte-exact REST-lane CONTENT read-back of a DRAFT is STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE against this Plane edition. The activities sub-resource uses `Issue.objects` (the unfiltered soft-deletion manager) and therefore IS the REST lane that can address a draft.

work_item_list_probe.note: the list endpoint also excludes drafts (same manager)

verdict.readback_channel_deviation: Plane's external REST work-item endpoints (LIST + DETAIL) query through `Issue.issue_objects`, which EXCLUDES draft work items — so no REST work-item route can render a draft's payload, and the MCP retrieve verbs inherit the same 404. The REST lane therefore proves EXISTENCE + WORKSPACE + PROJECT + CREATION EVENT through the activities sub-resource (which uses the unfiltered `Issue.objects`), while the CONTENT + is_draft assertions come from the Plane server's own create response and from PM's captured create arguments. This is a PLATFORM CONSTRAINT of the Plane edition, not an agent or lane defect.
